name: Wet Streets 💧
source: Kenzie’s surprise was clear when she walked in the aftermath of the midnight rain. The streets were dead except for one lonely soul. A soul as hot and horny as her own! In no time at all, the two latex lovers get the streets dirty all over again! A rain is coming, but this time, it’s hot and steamy!
translation: 午夜暴雨初歇，独自漫步街头的肯齐满心意外：死寂的街道上空无一人，唯独游荡着另一个孤独的灵魂——一个和她一样滚烫饥渴的灵魂！转眼之间，这对痴迷乳胶紧身衣的欢场男女便让洗净的街道再度染上靡乱气息！又一场骤雨即将来临，只不过这一次，注定湿热而缠绵！
